name: scitex_live_paper
label: Live Paper
subtitle: Read-only live paper viewer (PDF.js + claims + DAG)
about: Renders an accepted manuscript bundle as a live paper: PDF.js viewer with claim anchors, claims panel, mermaid DAG navigator, verification badge. Consumes the claim model owned by scitex-clew — never defines it.
description: scitex-live-paper is the published-side viewer for AI-verifiable research papers. M1 is the read-only static-site renderer; M2 wires the re-verify button (clew.verify_claim against pinned commit); M3 mounts this Django app under /viewer-v2/ on scitex-hub. The Django app pattern (SPA shell + <path:endpoint> api_dispatch + HANDLERS registry) mirrors scitex_writer._django.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Render accepted manuscript bundles to a self-contained static site
Mermaid DAG navigator with click-to-claim wiring
M3: mount as Django app on scitex-hub /viewer-v2/
